environment.description: Same Go microservice deployed on EKS (1.28) with an Envoy sidecar (v1.29) injected via Istio service mesh. The Envoy sidecar is configured with a custom ext_authz filter that delegates session token minting and validation to a Luna Network HSM 7 (firmware 7.8.2) via PKCS#11. The HSM holds an AES-256-GCM wrapping key (CKA_EXTRACTABLE=false, CKA_SENSITIVE=true) used to produce authenticated-encrypted session tokens. The ext_authz filter intercepts all responses containing Set-Cookie headers matching pattern 'SESSIONID=*' and replaces the cookie value with an HSM-minted AEAD token binding the session ID to a server-generated nonce stored in the HSM's session object cache. On inbound requests, the filter validates the AEAD tag via the HSM before forwarding; any cookie value not produced by the HSM (i.e., attacker-chosen session IDs) fails AEAD verification and the request receives a new session. The PKCS#11 session uses CKF_RW_SESSION with SO authentication, and the wrapping key has CKA_WRAP_WITH_TRUSTED=true requiring the HSM's built-in trust anchor chain.

config.ext_authz_filter: custom gRPC filter for session token minting/validation
config.hsm: Thales Luna Network HSM 7, firmware 7.8.2, PKCS#11 interface
config.session_binding: AEAD token wrapping session ID + server nonce, validated on every request
config.cookie_handling: Envoy rewrites outbound SESSIONID cookies with HSM-minted tokens; inbound cookies failing AEAD validation trigger new session creation
config.network_policy: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts pod egress to HSM endpoint only on port 1792
